units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1) the supplier (contractor, service provider) shall use the unified information system to prepare the decision, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorised to act on its behalf, and post it in that system. In the cases specified in Article 103(5) of this Federal Law, the decision shall not be posted on the official website;
units.label: Point 1 Part 20.1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 2) no later than one hour after being posted in the unified information system under point 1 of this paragraph, the decision shall automatically be sent through that system to the contracting authority. The date of receipt by the contracting authority shall be the date on which the decision is posted in the system under this point, according to the time zone in which the contracting authority is located;
units.label: Point 2 Part 20.1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 3) receipt of the decision under point 2 of this paragraph shall constitute proper notification of the contracting authority of the unilateral refusal to perform the contract.
units.label: Point 3 Part 20.1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 20.2. Where the supplier (contractor, service provider) decides under paragraph 19 of this Article to refuse unilaterally to perform a contract concluded following a closed tender or closed auction, or in procurement under Article 93 (except procurement under Article 93(12) of this Federal Law), Article 111 (where special arrangements established under Article 111(1) of this Federal Law provide that information and documents are not posted in the unified information system or on the official website during supplier (contractor, service provider) selection) or Article 111.1 of this Federal Law, the decision shall be delivered personally against acknowledgement to a person authorised to act on behalf of the contracting authority, or sent to the contracting authority by registered post with acknowledgement of receipt at its contractual address. Compliance with this paragraph by the supplier (contractor, service provider) constitutes proper notification of the contracting authority of the unilateral refusal. The date of proper notification shall be:
units.label: Part 20.2 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1) the date stated by the person authorised to act on behalf of the contracting authority in the acknowledgement of receipt of the decision (if delivered personally against acknowledgement to such an authorised person);
units.label: Point 1 Part 20.2 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 2) the date on which the supplier (contractor, service provider) receives confirmation of delivery to the contracting authority of the registered letter provided for in this paragraph, or receives information that the contracting authority is absent from the contractual address or that the letter has been returned after expiry of its retention period (if the decision is sent by registered letter).
units.label: Point 2 Part 20.2 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 21. The supplier's (contractor's, service provider's) decision to refuse performance unilaterally shall enter into force, and the contract shall be deemed terminated, ten days after the date on which it properly notified the contracting authority of that refusal.
units.label: Part 21 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 22. The supplier (contractor, service provider) shall cancel a decision to refuse performance unilaterally that has not yet entered into force if the contractual breaches giving rise to the decision are remedied within ten days of proper notification of the contracting authority.
units.label: Part 22 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 22.1. If the supplier (contractor, service provider) cancels, under this Federal Law, a decision to refuse performance unilaterally that has not yet entered into force and was posted in the unified information system under paragraph 20.1 of this Article, no later than the day following cancellation it shall use that system to prepare a notice of cancellation, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorised to act on its behalf, and post it in that system. In the cases specified in Article 103(5) of this Federal Law, the notice shall not be posted on the official website.
units.label: Part 22.1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 22.2. No later than two working days following the day on which the supplier's decision to refuse performance unilaterally enters into force, the contracting authority shall submit, in the procedure specified in Article 104(10)(1) of this Federal Law, a request to enter information on the supplier (contractor, service provider) in the register of bad-faith suppliers (contractors, service providers).
units.label: Part 22.2 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 23. When a contract is terminated because one party unilaterally refuses to perform, the other party may claim compensation only for actual loss directly caused by the circumstances constituting the grounds for that decision.
units.label: Part 23 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 24. Repealed from 1 July 2019. — Federal Law of 01.05.2019 No. 71-FZ.
units.label: Part 24 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 25. Special rules for the parties' decisions to refuse performance unilaterally in procurement of goods, work or services under the State defence order may be established by Federal Law No. 275-FZ of 29 December 2012 On the State Defence Order.
units.label: Part 25 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 26. Repealed from 1 July 2018. — Federal Law of 31.12.2017 No. 504-FZ.
units.label: Part 26 Art. 95

units.text: Article 96. Security for contract performance
units.label: Art. 96

units.text: 1. Except in the cases specified in paragraph 2 of this Article, the contracting authority shall require performance security in the procurement notice, procurement documentation, draft contract and invitation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 96

units.text: 1.1. In procurement involving a life-cycle contract, the contracting authority shall require performance security in the procurement notice, procurement documentation (where this Federal Law requires documentation), draft contract and invitation, separately for:
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 96

units.text: 1) delivery of goods or performance of work (including, where necessary, design of a capital construction facility or creation of goods to be produced as a result of the work);
units.label: Point 1 Part 1.1 Art. 96

units.text: 2) subsequent maintenance, operation throughout the service life where necessary, repair and/or disposal of the goods delivered or of the capital construction facility or goods created as a result of the work.
units.label: Point 2 Part 1.1 Art. 96

units.text: 2. The contracting authority may require performance security in the procurement notice and draft contract for an electronic request for quotations (except the case specified in Article 24(10)(2)(б) of this Federal Law), and for procurement under Article 93(1) of this Federal Law, points 1, 2 (unless the legal acts referred to in that point oblige the contracting authority to require performance security), 3–11, 13–15, 17, 20–23, 26, 28–34, 40–42, 44, 45, 46, 47–48 (if contracts under points 47–48 do not provide for an advance), 51–53, 55–59 and 61–63.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 96

units.text: 2.1. Repealed from 1 January 2017. — Federal Law of 29.12.2015 No. 390-FZ.
units.label: Part 2.1 Art. 96

units.text: 2.2. If requirements for warranty obligations are set under Article 33(4) of this Federal Law, the contracting authority may require security for those obligations in the procurement notice, procurement documentation, draft contract and invitation. Such security may not exceed ten percent of the initial (maximum) contract price or the price of a contract with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider).
units.label: Part 2.2 Art. 96

units.text: 3. Contract performance and warranty obligations may be secured by an independent guarantee satisfying Article 45 of this Federal Law, or by depositing cash in the account designated by the contracting authority and used under Russian Federation legislation to record transactions involving funds received by it. The procurement participant with whom the contract is concluded shall independently choose the form of performance or warranty security and the term of the independent guarantee in accordance with this Federal Law. The guarantee's term shall exceed by at least one month the contractual period for performance of the obligations secured, including where that period is changed under Article 95 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 96

units.text: 4. The contract shall be concluded after the procurement participant with whom it is to be concluded provides performance security in accordance with this Federal Law. A life-cycle contract shall be concluded after that participant provides security for the part specified in paragraph 1.1(1) of this Article.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 96

units.text: 5. If the procurement participant with whom the contract is to be concluded fails to provide performance security within the period set for conclusion, it shall be deemed to have evaded conclusion of the contract.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 96

units.text: 6. Where the contracting authority requires performance security under this Article, its amount shall be set under this Federal Law in the procurement notice, procurement documentation, draft contract and invitation at between one half percent and thirty percent of the initial (maximum) contract price, except in the cases specified in paragraphs 6.1–6.2-1 of this Article. Where:
units.label: Part 6 Art. 96

units.text: 1) the contract provides for an advance payment, performance security shall be at least equal to the advance, except in the case specified in point 3 of this paragraph;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6 Art. 96

units.text: 2) the advance exceeds thirty percent of the initial (maximum) contract price, performance security shall equal the advance;
units.label: Point 2 Part 6 Art. 96

units.text: 3) contractual advance payments are subject to treasury support under Russian Federation legislation, the contracting authority shall calculate performance security from the initial (maximum) contract price (or from the contract price in the case specified in paragraph 6.2 of this Article when the contract follows supplier (contractor, service provider) selection under Article 30(1)(1) of this Federal Law), in either case reduced by the amount of that advance.
units.label: Point 3 Part 6 Art. 96

units.text: 6.1. If contract settlements are subject to treasury support under Russian Federation legislation, the contracting authority may refrain from requiring performance security. If it does require security, the amount shall be up to ten percent of the initial (maximum) contract price, or of the contract price in the case specified in paragraph 6.2 of this Article when the contract follows supplier (contractor, service provider) selection under Article 30(1)(1) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 6.1 Art. 96

units.text: 6.2. If the contract follows supplier (contractor, service provider) selection under Article 30(1)(1) of this Federal Law and the contracting authority requires performance security, its amount shall be set under paragraphs 6 and 6.1 of this Article using the price at which the contract is concluded under this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 6.2 Art. 96

units.text: 6.2-1. For a life-cycle contract, where the contracting authority requires performance security:
units.label: Part 6.2-1 Art. 96

units.text: 1) security for the part specified in paragraph 1.1(1) of this Article shall be set under paragraphs 6 and 6.1 of this Article in the procurement notice, procurement documentation (where this Federal Law requires documentation) for the procurement resulting in the life-cycle contract, draft contract and invitation, using the cost of the goods or work, including, where necessary, the cost of preparing design documentation or creating goods;
units.label: Point 1 Part 6.2-1 Art. 96

units.text: 2) security for the part specified in paragraph 1.1(2) of this Article shall be set under paragraphs 6 and 6.1 of this Article in the procurement notice, procurement documentation (where this Federal Law requires documentation) for the procurement resulting in the life-cycle contract, draft contract and invitation, at up to ten percent of the cost of subsequent maintenance, operation throughout the service life where necessary, repair and/or disposal of the goods delivered or of the capital construction facility or goods created as a result of the work.
units.label: Point 2 Part 6.2-1 Art. 96

units.text: 6.3. If the price or total of unit prices of goods, work or services offered in a participant's application is twenty-five percent or more below the initial (maximum) contract price or initial total of unit prices, the participant with whom the contract is concluded shall provide performance security taking account of Article 37 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 6.3 Art. 96

units.text: 7. During contract performance, the supplier (contractor, service provider) may change the form of performance security and/or replace the security previously provided to the contracting authority with new security, whose amount may be reduced in the manner and cases specified in paragraphs 7.2 and 7.3 of this Article. It may change the form of warranty security and/or replace previously provided warranty security with new warranty security.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 96

units.text: 7.1. If the contract provides for separate performance stages and requires performance security, its amount shall be reduced during performance in the manner and cases specified in paragraphs 7.2 and 7.3 of this Article.
units.label: Part 7.1 Art. 96

units.text: 7.2. Performance security shall be reduced by the contracting authority sending information on the supplier's (contractor's, service provider's) performance of obligations to deliver goods, perform work (its results) or provide services, or of a separate contract stage, and the value of those obligations, for inclusion in the relevant contract register under Article 103 of this Federal Law. The reduction shall be proportional to the value of obligations performed, accepted and paid for in the manner and within the periods specified in the contract. If security is an independent guarantee, the contracting authority's demand for payment under it may not exceed the security amount it calculates from the performance information in the relevant contract register. If security is cash deposited in the account designated by the contracting authority, at the supplier's (contractor's, service provider's) request the contracting authority shall return, within the contractual period set under Article 34(27) of this Federal Law, the amount by which the security has been reduced, calculated from the performance information in the relevant contract register.
units.label: Part 7.2 Art. 96

units.text: 7.3. Reductions under paragraphs 7 and 7.1 of this Article require that no claims for penalties (fines or delay penalties) made by the contracting authority under this Federal Law remain unfulfilled by the supplier (contractor, service provider), and that the contracting authority has accepted goods, work (its results), services or separate-stage results equal in value to the advance paid, if the contract provides for an advance, or exceeding that advance if advance payments are subject to treasury support under Russian Federation legislation. Reduction is not permitted in cases determined by the Government of the Russian Federation to ensure national defence capability and security and protect the health, rights and lawful interests of citizens of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 7.3 Art. 96

units.text: 8. The provisions of this Federal Law on performance security, including security taking account of Article 37 of this Federal Law, and on warranty security shall not apply where:
units.label: Part 8 Art. 96

units.text: 1) the contract is concluded with a procurement participant that is a treasury institution;
units.label: Point 1 Part 8 Art. 96

units.text: 2) a lending service is procured;
units.label: Point 2 Part 8 Art. 96

units.text: 3) a budget-funded institution or a State or municipal unitary enterprise concludes a contract for issue of an independent guarantee.
units.label: Point 3 Part 8 Art. 96

units.text: 8.1. A participant with whom a contract is concluded following supplier (contractor, service provider) selection under Article 30(1)(1) of this Federal Law shall be exempt from performance security, including security taking account of Article 37 of this Federal Law, and warranty security if it supplies information from the register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities confirming that, without taking account of legal succession, it performed three contracts during the three years before submitting its procurement application without penalties (fines or delay penalties) being imposed on it. The participant shall provide this information before conclusion, in the cases in which this Federal Law requires performance security to be provided. The sum of those contract prices shall be at least the initial (maximum) contract price specified in the procurement notice and documentation.
units.label: Part 8.1 Art. 96

units.text: 9. Repealed from 1 January 2022. — Federal Law of 02.07.2021 No. 360-FZ.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 96

units.text: 10. Special rules for the performance security provided for in this Article in the State defence order sphere may be established by Federal Law No. 275-FZ of 29 December 2012 On the State Defence Order.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 96

units.text: 11. Repealed from 1 January 2017. — Federal Law of 29.12.2015 No. 390-FZ.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 96

units.text: Chapter 4. PROCUREMENT MONITORING AND AUDIT
units.label: Chapter 4. PROCUREMENT MONITORING AND AUDIT

units.text: Article 97. Procurement monitoring
units.label: Art. 97

units.text: 1. Procurement monitoring is a system of continuous observation in the procurement sphere through the collection, aggregation, systematisation and evaluation of procurement information, including implementation of procurement schedules.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 97

units.text: 2. Repealed from 1 October 2019. — Federal Law of 01.05.2019 No. 71-FZ.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 97

units.text: 3. Procurement monitoring shall use the unified information system and the information it contains.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 97

units.text: 4. Monitoring of procurement for State and municipal needs shall be ensured by the federal executive authority regulating the contractual procurement system in the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 97

units.text: 5. The results of procurement monitoring for each year shall be recorded in a consolidated analytical report submitted to the Government of the Russian Federation by the federal executive authority regulating the contractual procurement system. The Government of the Russian Federation shall determine the requirements for the report's content and preparation procedure and the time limits for its preparation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 97

units.text: 6. The consolidated analytical report shall evaluate the efficiency of procurement of goods, work and services for State and municipal needs and identify measures to improve Russian Federation legislation and other regulatory legal acts on the contractual procurement system.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 97

units.text: 7. The consolidated analytical report shall be posted in the unified information system.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 97

units.text: 8. Under acts of the highest executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and of local administrations, the constituent entities' executive authorities regulating the contractual procurement system and local self-government bodies may monitor procurement for constituent-entity and municipal needs respectively.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 97

units.text: 9. The procedure for using the unified information system for procurement monitoring shall be established taking account of the system's operating procedure set under Article 4(2) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 97

units.text: 10. Repealed. — Federal Law of 04.06.2014 No. 140-FZ.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 97

units.text: Article 98. Procurement audit
units.label: Art. 98

units.text: 1. Procurement audit shall be conducted by the Accounts Chamber of the Russian Federation, the audit and accounts bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation established by their legislative bodies, and the municipal audit and accounts bodies established by municipal representative bodies, where such bodies have been established in the municipalities.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 98

units.text: 2. The bodies specified in paragraph 1 of this Article, hereinafter procurement audit bodies, shall analyse and evaluate procurement results and achievement of procurement objectives within their powers.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 98

units.text: 3. To achieve the objectives specified in paragraph 2 of this Article, procurement audit bodies shall conduct expert analytical, informational and other activities by examining, analysing and evaluating information on the legality, expediency, justification, timeliness, efficiency and effectiveness of procurement expenditure under contracts planned for conclusion, concluded contracts and completed contracts.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 98

units.text: 4. Procurement audit bodies shall aggregate the results of the activities specified in paragraph 3 of this Article, including identifying the causes of deviations, violations and shortcomings found; prepare proposals to eliminate them and improve the contractual procurement system; systematise information on implementation of those proposals; and post aggregated information on the results in the unified information system.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 98
